facts.fact: The World Bank PID says the first phase of social registry data collection was completed in December 2025 in Mangwe district, extending to Nkayi and Mudzi to cover two percent of the population, with ZISO still needing large-scale enumeration to be fully operational.

systems.system: ZISO (formerly Integrated Social Protection Management Information System, ISPMIS)
systems.owner: Ministry of Public Service, Labor, and Social Welfare
